# GoWithDME

> GoWithDME is an information and community portal for concerts, festivals, expos, and hiking trips in cities across Indonesia, with features for finding travel companions (meet-up invites) and per-city communities. GoWithDME is not a ticket seller and not an event organizer.
> GoWithDME adalah portal informasi dan komunitas untuk konser, festival, pameran, dan open trip naik gunung di kota-kota Indonesia, dengan fitur cari teman jalan (ajakan barengan) dan komunitas per kota. GoWithDME bukan penjual tiket dan bukan penyelenggara acara.

Also written: GoWithDME.com, Go With DME. Not affiliated with other brands with similar names (for example GoWithGuide, GoWit, GoFundMe, GoTo). Official domain: gowithdme.com. Languages: Indonesian (/id/) and English (/en/).

## Key facts
- Coverage: 38 provinces and 120+ cities/regencies in Indonesia (filter by macro-region, province, city, or nearby radius).
- Content: concerts, festivals, expos, and hiking open trips, curated in one place with date, venue, price, line-up, and official ticket link.
- Features: event search, Dea AI (assistant for event questions), meet-up invites (find company to attend an event), per-city communities, hiking packing checklist and cost splitter.
- GoWithDME does NOT sell tickets, does NOT organize events, and is NOT a party to any transaction. Buy tickets only from the official seller or organizer.
- Founder and operator: Kalfin Agus Setiawan. Privacy policy follows Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 27/2022).
- Contact: halo@gowithdme.com (replies usually within 24 hours).
- Origin: the founder attended a music festival alone, felt lost in the crowd, and built GoWithDME so people can find companions.

## Main pages (English)
- [GoWithDME — Find Friends for Festivals & Hikes in Your City](https://gowithdme.com/en/): GoWithDME: an information portal for concerts, festivals, and hiking trips in Indonesia, plus finding travel companions (meet-up invites) and city communities. Not a ticket seller.
- [All Events — GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/en/event): All active concerts, expos, and hiking events, filterable by city, time, and price.
- [Mountain Hiking — GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/en/gunung): Open trips and hiking schedules, packing checklist, and cost-split calculator.
- [Find Company — GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/en/teman): Find company for concerts, hikes, sports, food, study, and more. Invites by city, province, all Indonesia, or online.
- [Community — Find Friends for Festivals & Hikes | GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/en/komunitas): GoWithDME community by city: find friends for concerts and hikes, ask questions, and share tips with fellow goers.
- [Help & FAQ — GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/en/bantuan): Answers to common questions about accounts, events, invites, and safety, plus how to contact GoWithDME.
- [About GoWithDME — Concerts, Festivals & Travel Companions in Indonesia](https://gowithdme.com/en/about): GoWithDME is an information portal for concerts, festivals, hiking, and finding travel companions in Indonesia. Origin story, how it works, owner (Kalfin Agus Setiawan), partnerships, and contact. Not a ticket seller.
- [Privacy Policy — GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/en/privacy): GoWithDME Privacy Policy: what data is collected, how it is used, your rights, and contact, aligned with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 27/2022).
- [Terms & Conditions — GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/en/terms): GoWithDME Terms & Conditions: GoWithDME is not a ticket seller or event organizer and not a party to any transaction; rules for accounts, meet-up invites, and content.
- [Copyright & Ownership — GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/en/copyright): Owner and operator of GoWithDME (Kalfin Agus Setiawan), content and poster copyright, and how to request removal.

## Halaman utama (Indonesia)
- [GoWithDME — Cari Teman Nonton Festival & Naik Gunung di Kotamu](https://gowithdme.com/id/): GoWithDME: portal info konser, festival, dan open trip naik gunung di Indonesia, plus cari teman jalan (ajakan barengan) dan komunitas per kota. Bukan penjual tiket.
- [Semua Event — GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/id/event): Semua event konser, pameran, dan naik gunung yang aktif, bisa disaring menurut kota, waktu, dan harga.
- [Niche Gunung — GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/id/gunung): Open trip dan jadwal naik gunung, daftar perlengkapan, dan kalkulator patungan biaya.
- [Cari Teman Bareng — GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/id/teman): Cari teman untuk konser, naik gunung, olahraga, kuliner, belajar, dan banyak lagi. Ajakan per kota, provinsi, seluruh Indonesia, atau online.
- [Komunitas — Cari Teman Nonton Festival & Naik Gunung | GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/id/komunitas): Komunitas GoWithDME per kota: cari teman nonton konser dan naik gunung, tanya info, dan bagi tips bareng sesama pengunjung.
- [Bantuan & FAQ — GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/id/bantuan): Jawaban untuk pertanyaan umum soal akun, event, ajakan, dan keamanan, plus cara menghubungi GoWithDME.
- [Tentang GoWithDME — Portal Konser, Festival & Teman Jalan Indonesia](https://gowithdme.com/id/about): GoWithDME adalah portal info konser, festival, naik gunung, dan cari teman seperjalanan di Indonesia. Cerita awal, cara kerja, pemilik (Kalfin Agus Setiawan), kerja sama, dan kontak. Bukan penjual tiket.
- [Kebijakan Privasi — GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/id/privacy): Kebijakan Privasi GoWithDME: data apa yang dikumpulkan, cara dipakai, hak pengguna, dan kontak, selaras dengan UU PDP (UU No. 27/2022).
- [Syarat & Ketentuan — GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/id/terms): Syarat & Ketentuan GoWithDME: GoWithDME bukan penjual tiket atau penyelenggara acara dan bukan pihak dalam transaksi apa pun; aturan akun, ajakan barengan, dan konten.
- [Hak Cipta & Kepemilikan — GoWithDME](https://gowithdme.com/id/copyright): Pemilik dan operator GoWithDME (Kalfin Agus Setiawan), hak cipta konten dan poster, serta cara mengajukan penghapusan.
